svg.title: Event buses, rules and targets
svg.desc: Three sources on the left: an AWS service, an application and a SaaS partner. The AWS service sends to the default event bus, the application to a custom event bus, and the SaaS partner to a partner event bus. Rules on the default and partner buses point to targets such as a Lambda function, an SQS queue and an SNS topic; an event on the custom bus matches no rule.
